title: [Salty's Services, Foyer]
description: Opening off of a wide driftwood arch, the area is cavernous and spare, with high ceilings and a plain wooden floor scattered with loose sand.  Varied multihued banners line the wooden walls, each adorned with the sewn-on image of a stylized kraken.  Above, a metal brazier hangs from the ceiling, casting a dim light across the warehouse entry.  A narrow winding stairway disappears upward into the warehouse's second floor, while a broad kelp-lined curtain opposite the arch leads further inward.
